base.structure: All813 header tensor names/shapes match the native full-size meta model; contents not downloaded/tested
base.config: Released base uses one flow draw and fast_skip_tokens128; source defaults5 and1152 are not silently substituted

native_math: PaliGemma/Gemma/SigLIP and timestep adaRMS reuse the platform OpenPI implementation
Block-diagonal independent flow draws share one VLM prefix, reset RoPE positions per draw, and cannot attend to teacher-forced FAST codes
KI detaches VLM K/V only for expert queries; text/FAST gradients train the VLM
Text token-mean CE plus1e-4 z-loss; per-action-sample FAST code-only CE; actual-coordinate flow mean
Native local UniversalActionProcessor DCT/BPE encoding without executing remote Python
FP32 math SDPA in joint attention, matching the official FineART setting; native OpenPI token embeddings are explicitly scaled while current Transformers uses scaled embedding modules

data.paper_protocol: FineART:14 named joint/gripper coordinates,30Hz,cam_high/cam_left_wrist/cam_right_wrist, timestamped subtask captions
data.robot_adaptation: Explicit selected recorded units/fields; train-only quantiles+1e-6 without clipping; no inferred relative-joint/EE semantics
data.annotations: Optional shared reader envelope; required persistent column for this recipe; recorded timestamp matching, deterministic episode/frame blend; no fabricated labels
data.supervision: 30% high-level task->active subtask text,70% low-level subtask/state->action; repeated episode tails retained
data.spatial_vqa: Named per-camera paired question/answer events; normalized image xy/xyxy, strict finite ordered coordinates; PaliGemma label-first loc targets; no unit or camera inference
data.fast_fitting: Rank0 only, train windows only, deterministic disjoint fit/validation samples; DCT/BPE scale10, target vocabulary1024; RMSE<=0.1/max-dim<=0.2; complete ByteLevel alphabet fixes unseen-coefficient byte loss in small fits

limits: Tool calls and memory scratchpad controllers are not included
Invalid/missing labels, non-normalized spatial coordinates and incomplete FAST chunks fail explicitly
Old released FAST mapping overlaps loc tokens; spatial VQA with FAST requires an explicit skip>=1152
Episode termination uses the evaluation duration or user stop; no invented completion labels
Optional Liger/FlashRT/FlexAttention and process-global kernel patches are not enabled
Small-model CPU/CUDA/backward/cache/controller/checkpoint/resume tests do not establish full-base convergence or distributed readiness
runtime: Optional generic observation-time subtask controller; preserves high-level task, clears queues on phase change, resets per episode; independent NativePolicy language/VQA query API
